title: ODAPM Scope Item (odapm/v1)
description: Vendor-neutral description of a restoration line item. Defines what work exists and how it is structured, independent of any proprietary code set.

id.description: Stable slug, unique within the model.

group.description: Estimate section this item belongs to.

desc.description: One-line explanation of what the item covers.

estVerb.description: Optional verb used when rendering the estimate line.

categoryPriced.description: True if the unit price varies by water category (cat1/cat2/cat3).

repeatable.description: True if the item can appear per-room/per-area.

pick.description: Optional choice set (e.g. action detach vs remove & dispose, or material/size).
